You will need to wait for a future, unreleased software update, presumably the combined Spring Update with V14.3.2 once it’s brought to the 2026.14 or later branches.

As a rule of thumb, if the third number (200, in 2026.2.200) than (9, in 2026.2.9.10), it’s not eligible. 👍

We’ve received *dozens* of replies and DMs about this, so here’s an important clarification.

If you are currently on a factory update such as 2026.2.100, 2026.2.200, 2026.2.200.1:

Your vehicle is NOT eligible to receive any current FSD V14.3.2 updates, including 2026.2.9.10.
